name: Mute the quest timer sounds
description: Silences the two sounds the solo-quest countdown makes: que_time_ext_01 (the jingle played when the timer is extended) and que_warning_01 (the low-time warning that repeats while the timer runs low). The game reads per-cue volumes from a SoundDB table held inside App/rom/sound/se_quest.farc, and each cue's volume is a single ASCII digit there. This sets both to '0', which is two bytes: offset 3013098, the '8' of que_time_ext_01, and offset 3013168, the '7' of que_warning_01. The mod carries those two offsets and their new bytes rather than a copy of the 3 MB archive, so no game file ships with it. Both cues and their audio stay present, every other cue keeps its volume, and the rest of the file is byte-for-byte untouched. The patch is guarded by the archive size, so a build the offsets were not measured against is left alone instead of being written at the wrong place. This container is the uppercase-'FARC' sound archive, not the packed 'FARc' master-data archive, so the offsets are the only handle on it.
